name: What is a detached guest suite?

mainEntity.name: What is a detached guest suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: A detached guest suite is a separate living space on your property, independent of the main house. It typically includes a bedroom, bathroom, and often a small kitchenette or living area. These structures are ideal for housing guests, extended family, or can serve as a private home office, studio, or rental unit. Building a detached suite requires careful planning to ensure it complements your existing property and complies with local zoning regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: A detached guest suite is a self-contained living space separate from your main home, often used for guests, family, or as a rental.
